test.title: Electrochemistry - Test 5

test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text:
The standard reduction potentials at 295 K for the following half cells are given below:

NO3-+4H++3e-→NOg+2H2O Eo=0.97 V
V2+aq+2e-→Vs Eo=-1.19 V
Fe3+aq+3e-→Fes Eo=-0.04 V
Ag+aq+e-→Ags Eo=0.80 V
Au3+aq+3e-→Aus Eo=1.40 V

The number of metal(s) which will be oxidised by NO3- in aqueous solution is _____.

The resistance of conductivity cell with cell constant <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>14</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>, containing <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>001</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mo> </mo><mi>KCl</mi></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>298</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1500</mn><mi>Ω</mi></math>. The molar conductivity of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>001</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mo> </mo><mi>KCl</mi></math> solution at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>298</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi>cm</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> is (Integer answer)

The cell potential for ZnZn2+(aq)‖Snx+Sn is 0.801V at 298 K. The reaction quotient for the above reaction is 10-2. The number of electrons involved in the given electrochemical cell reaction is _____ .
(Given EZn2+∣Zn0=-0.763 V,ESnx+|Sn0=+0.008 V and 2.303RTF=0.06 V)

<math><mn>108 </mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of silver (molar mass <math><mn>108 </mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> ) is deposited at cathode from <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">q</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> solution by a certain quantity of electricity. EFeO42-/Fe2+θ is x×10-3 V. The value of x is _______

PtsH2gH+aqAg+aqAgs

The value of ΔfG⊖ is kJmol-1. (in nearest integer)

Potassium chlorate is prepared by electrolysis of KCl in basic solution as shown by following equation.

6OH-+Cl-→ClO3-+3H2O+6e-

A current of xA has to be passed for 10 h to produce 10.0 g of potassium chlorate. the value of x is __________. (Nearest integer)

(Molar mass of KClO3=122.6 g mol-1 F=96500 C)

(Given: ESn2+Sn0=-0.14 V,EPb2+Pb0=-0.13 V,  2.303RTF=0.06)

Cus+Sn2+0.001M→Cu2+0.01M+Sns

The Gibbs free energy change for the above reaction at 298 K is x×10-1 kJ mol-1. The value of x is____[nearest integer]

[Given : ECu2+/Cu⊖=0.34 V;ESn2+/Sn⊖=-0.14 V;F=96500Cmol-1]
